This file is the ONE source of truth. Both layers read it and neither duplicates the value:
- bash : scripts/ci/resolve-full-suite-policy.sh  (consumed by the CI workflow)
Flipping `status` to RETIRED is the ONLY supported way to restore the automatic
schedule/push-to-base Full Suite. That is a governance act reserved for the consolidated
closure (policy doc s10) and must never be done as a side effect of another sprint.

authorised_manual_path.note: Both inputs must be true. This is the consolidated-closure path and stays usable while ACTIVE.

retirement.requires: explicit user revocation, or completed consolidated Full Suite closure
retirement.forbidden: retiring this policy as a side effect of an unrelated sprint
